content.short: Levl is stablecoin payments infrastructure for instant, low-cost global payments and on/off-ramps.
content.description: Levl is a Swiss stablecoin payments infrastructure provider. Its payment suite lets businesses send and receive global payments in fiat or stablecoins, with named accounts, stablecoin liquidity, on and off-ramps and remittances, settling instantly and around the clock. Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists Levl.
content.meta: Levl provides stablecoin payment infrastructure with instant settlement and on/off-ramps, listed on Plasma.
